title: ourisia macrocarpa subsp. calycina
intro: Ourisia macrocarpa subsp. calycina, commonly known as Mountain Mint or Alpine Mint, is a subspecies of the Ourisia macrocarpa plant. This plant is native to New Zealand and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. Ourisia macrocarpa subsp. calycina is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its potential to alleviate digestive issues and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids and phenolic acids, that exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
